descriptionAdvanced.en: The National Customs Office in El Alto is a critical administrative and logistical nerve center for Bolivia's international trade. Located adjacent to the El Alto International Airport, this facility manages the processing, taxation, and inspection of a vast majority of the high-value goods entering or leaving the country by air. It serves as a vital gatekeeper for the national economy, ensuring compliance with trade regulations and collecting essential revenue for the state. The complex includes massive warehouses, specialized labs for product testing, and advanced scanning technology to detect illegal shipments. Given El Alto's role as a major commercial hub for the La Paz region, this customs point is essential for the smooth operation of businesses ranging from small importers to large industrial manufacturers.

en: El Alto customs is one of the highest-revenue collecting points for the Bolivian National Customs (ANB).
It handles a wide variety of cargo, including electronics, pharmaceuticals, and specialized mining equipment.
The facility operates 24/7 to facilitate the rapid movement of perishable and urgent air freight.
It is a primary site for the implementation of modern digital customs procedures aimed at reducing bureaucracy.
